{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, abrasive sound is less appealing right now than the melodic or intricate heavy music in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Melodic vocals and elaborate heavy guitar work fit my interest in energetic metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I want more of Tool's intricate rhythms and immersive atmosphere.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of aggression and melody suits my interest in Disturbed and heavier albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intricate heavy riffs appeal, but I would choose albums closer to my recent listening this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic hard rock fits part of my history, but I am more interested in heavier material today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intensity and unusual rhythms appeal, but other choices fit my current mood more closely.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mer De Noms; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its atmospheric, melodic heaviness feels like a natural next choice after Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rust in Peace; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The technical guitar work fits my heavier interests, but I would save it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sing The Sorrow; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic intensity connects with my rock listening, but progressive and heavier sounds are my priority now."}
